en_title: Nintendo Takes Down Switch Emulators and Mod Chip Firmware In Massive GitHub DMCA Sweep
cn_title: 任天堂通过大规模GitHub DMCA行动下架Switch模拟器和改机芯片固件
opus_summary: 任天堂向GitHub发出四份DMCA下架通知，针对Switch模拟器Yuzu、Citron Neo及改机芯片固件。GitHub已移除该固件的144个代码仓库，但据TorrentFreak报道，网站其他位置似乎仍有该固件。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo has sent four DMCA takedown notices to GitHub targeting two Nintendo Switch emulators, Yuzu and Citron Neo, along with mod chip firmware.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂已向GitHub发送了四份DMCA下架通知，针对两款任天堂Switch模拟器Yuzu和Citron Neo，以及改机芯片固件。

paragraphs.en: This isn't the first time Nintendo has sent takedown notices to GitHub, and it's not even the first time it's tried to take down Yuzu , but the focus this time around seems to be on firmware for mod chips. This particular firmware had 144 repositories, all of which have been removed by GitHub and replaced by a DMCA takedown notice. Mod chips like Picofly can be soldered onto the Nintendo Switch's mainboard, and can be flashed with this firmware to circumvent Nintendo's copy protection.
paragraphs.cn: 这不是任天堂第一次向GitHub发送下架通知，甚至也不是它第一次试图下架Yuzu，但这一次的重点似乎是改机芯片固件。这款固件有144个代码仓库，均已被GitHub移除，并替换为一份DMCA下架通知。Picofly等改机芯片可以焊接到任天堂Switch的主板上，并刷入这种固件，以绕过任天堂的复制保护。

paragraphs.en: GitHub has posted Nintendo's November 6 DMCA notice , which says, "The Nintendo Switch console and video games contain technological protection measures ('TPMs') that permit the Nintendo Switch console to interact only with legitimate Nintendo video game files. This process protects Nintendo’s copyright-protected video games, (...) by preventing users from playing pirated copies of Nintendo’s video games on the Nintendo Switch console and by preventing users from unlawfully copying and playing Nintendo’s video games on unauthorized devices."
paragraphs.cn: GitHub公布了任天堂11月6日发出的DMCA通知，其中写道：「任天堂Switch主机和电子游戏含有技术保护措施（‘TPM’），只允许任天堂Switch主机与正版任天堂电子游戏文件交互。这一过程通过阻止用户在任天堂Switch主机上游玩任天堂电子游戏的盗版，以及阻止用户在未经授权的设备上非法复制和游玩任天堂电子游戏，保护了任天堂受版权保护的电子游戏。（……）」

paragraphs.en: However, while this takedown has effectively wiped out a ton of repositories with mod chip firmware, it seems like it's still being hosted elsewhere on the site, according to TorrentFreak . It's possible, though, that Nintendo isn't finished yet; Back in 2024, Nintendo effectively took down 8,500 copies of Yuzu by issuing a takedown that targeted 12 different mirrors of the emulator.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，据TorrentFreak报道，虽然这次下架行动实际上清除了大量包含改机芯片固件的代码仓库，但该固件似乎仍托管在网站的其他位置。不过，任天堂可能还没有结束行动；早在2024年，任天堂就曾通过发出针对该模拟器12个不同镜像的下架通知，实际上下架了8500份Yuzu副本。

paragraphs.en: This particular takedown also comes a few days after emulators were able to run the remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on PC, so this could be a sign that Nintendo is winding up its lawyers to crack down on emulation once again.
paragraphs.cn: 此次下架行动还发生在模拟器能够在PC上运行《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版的几天后，因此这可能表明任天堂正准备让律师再次打击模拟器。

paragraphs.en: If anything, though, emulation is a completely different beast in 2026 than it was even in 2024, thanks to the rise of AI. There's already been a wave of AI-made mashup mods that took over Twitter for a couple of weeks, and led Anthropic to coding in a lock to prevent Claude from outright copying games . Game developers have started cracking down on AI ports of games, too. Just last month Rockstar had to take down a browser version of GTA 5 , and Bethesda took down an AI-generated Fallout New York game .
paragraphs.cn: 不过，由于AI的兴起，2026年的模拟器领域即便与2024年相比，也已完全不同。此前已有一波AI制作的混搭模组在X上风靡了几周，还促使Anthropic通过编程加入限制，防止Claude直接复制游戏。游戏开发商也已开始打击AI移植的游戏。就在上个月，Rockstar不得不下架《GTA5》的一个浏览器版本，贝塞斯达也下架了一款AI生成的《辐射New York》游戏。
